# npm runtime license inventory

Inventory of the exact runtime dependency tree in `package-lock.json`, checked
against the installed packages on 19 November 2026. Each package contained the
license file listed below. These packages are not bundled into the SDK tarball;
npm installs their own packages and notices separately.

| Package | Version | Declared license | License file in package |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| lossless-json | 4.3.4 | MIT | LICENSE.md |
| proper-lockfile | 4.1.2 | MIT | LICENSE |
| tar | 7.5.23 | BlueOak-1.0.0 | LICENSE.md |
| graceful-fs | 4.2.12 | BlueOak-1.0.0 | LICENSE.md |
| retry | 0.12.0 | MIT | License |
| signal-exit | 3.0.7 | ISC | LICENSE.txt |
| @isaacs/fs-minipass | 4.0.1 | ISC | LICENSE |
| chownr | 3.0.0 | BlueOak-1.0.0 | LICENSE.md |
| minipass | 7.1.3 | BlueOak-1.0.0 | LICENSE.md |

| yallist | 5.0.0 | BlueOak-1.0.0 | LICENSE.md |

The SDK's own MIT license and the Receita Federal notice for adapted examples
